course.title: Computer Networks
course.department: Department of Computer Science and Engineering

content.value: Suppose, a client wants to start an online service. He has five computers ready for this job. These are connected to the internet with IP addresses 212.212.212.101-105. He picked “Network utopia.com" as the domain name for the online service. Your job is to make the service accessible by anyone on the internet. What will be your steps to accomplish that? Explain briefly.
